title: 第十三章 兄弟相见！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

胖女人白其他人一眼，又谄媚道，“小灵，你说的太对了，三观决定人生嘛，叶凡虽也不错，但性格太执拗，的确和你不合适。”

“对对对…”

其他人纷纷附和，江灵这才一笑，但没在多说，反对胖女人道，“杨花，你就别说我了，说说你吧，听说你马上就要去蓝国了？”

胖女人眼中透出得意，“没错，我男朋友是蓝国华尔街交易员，他和他家说好了，到蓝国我们就结婚，直接拿绿卡。”

闻言，一高瘦青年一挑眉，“周云，你那男朋友我记得是个黑人吧，叫什么杰克对不对？他连英文都说不利索，这水平还在华尔街当交易员？你可别被骗了，最后蓝国没去成去了非洲，成了某部落酋长夫人。”

杨花脸色一变，破口大骂，“李成章！你他妈没完了是吧，我当初不就误会了你一次吗？怀疑你偷我内裤，但之后我就对你道歉了，你至于这么咒我！”

“我去你妈了个比吧！你也不看看你那肥比样子，跟他妈母猪一样，老子见你就想吐，还偷你内裤？你别恶心老子了行不行？”

李成章当场回击，“至于道歉，你当初那叫道歉？私底下给我说个对不起就完了？老子就是因为你才在大学被人笑话，所以没错，这事没完！老子就是见你一次骂你一次，你能咋的！”

“啊！我和你拼了！”

杨花肥肉颤抖，一下跳起。

李成章丝毫不惧，同样上前，其他人忙隔住两人，开始劝解。

“杨花，你别生气，都是同学，成章的嘴你也知道，一向毒的狠，你和他计较什么？”

“成章，你也住口，你怎么也是个男人，至于这么小肚鸡肠？”

李成章挑眉，“草！男人怎么了，男人就他妈该被女人栽赃了？而且老子说错什么了吗？老子看在和她是同学的份上，好心劝她别被骗，她倒好，上来就骂我，怎么着杨花，是不是那黑人活好，把你弄爽了，所以我一说他你就急？”

“啊！李成章，我草你妈！”

杨花尖叫，看向王岩，“王岩！这就是你请来的同学！这种嘴贱的货你也请吗！”

王岩脸色一沉，对李成章道，“成章，够了，都是同学，你当给我个面子，给杨花道个歉。”

“王岩，你装你妈呢？”

李成章眼神一寒，“她刚才骂我的时候你怎么不说话，现在过来装好人了，还让我给你面子，你算个吊？真当你家开几个破商超就牛逼了？你翘我兄弟叶凡女友的事我还没给你算呢！”

王岩拳头握紧，怒视李成章，李成章毫不在乎，“王岩，我实话告诉你，我今天来，第一是冲着骂杨花这肥比来的，第二就是专门警告你的！叶凡是我兄弟，你他妈翘他女朋友，那就是欺负我！所以你最好祈祷叶凡没事，不然，我整死你！”

Page (1/3)

The fat woman rolled her eyes at the others and said flatteringly, "Xiao Ling, you are so right. Three views determine life. Although Ye Fan is not bad, his personality is too stubborn and is really not suitable for you."

"Yes, yes..."

Others agreed, and Jiang Ling smiled, but didn't say much. He objected to the fat woman and said, "Yang Hua, don't talk about me, talk about you. I heard that you are going to the Blue Country soon?"

The fat woman's eyes showed pride, "Yes, my boyfriend is a Wall Street trader in Blue Country. He has made an agreement with his family that we will get married when we arrive in Blue Country and get a green card directly."

Hearing this, a tall and thin young man raised his eyebrows and said, "Zhou Yun, I remember your boyfriend is a black man. His name is Jack, right? He can't even speak English well, and he is still working as a trader on Wall Street at this level? Don't be fooled. In the end, the Blue Country didn't go to Africa and became the wife of a tribal chief."

Yang Hua's expression changed and he cursed loudly, "Li Chengzhang! You're done, aren't you? Didn't I misunderstand you once at the beginning? I suspected you of stealing my underwear, but I apologized to you afterwards, so you cursed me like this!"

"Let me go to your mother to compare! You don't look at your fat body, you look like a fucking sow. I feel like vomiting when I see you, and you steal your underwear? Can you please stop disgusting me?"

Li Chengzhang hit back on the spot, "As for an apology, did you call it an apology? Just say sorry to me in private and that's it? It's because of you that I was laughed at in college, so yes, this matter is never over! I just scold you every time I see you, what can you do!"

"Ah! I'll fight you!"

Yang Hua's fat body trembled and jumped up.

Li Chengzhang was not afraid at all and also stepped forward. The others hurriedly separated the two people and began to persuade them.

"Yang Hua, don't be angry. We are all classmates. You also know Cheng Zhang's mouth. He has always been vicious. Why do you have an issue with him?"

"Chengzhang, shut up. Why are you a man? How can you be so petty?"

Li Chengzhang raised his eyebrows, "Fuck! What's wrong with a man? A man should be framed by a woman? And did I say something wrong? For the sake of being her classmate, I kindly advised her not to be deceived. She was nice, but she scolded me when she first came up. Why are you fooling around? Is that black man living a good life and making you happy, so you get anxious when I talk about him?"

"Ah! Li Chengzhang, I'll fuck your mother!"

Yang Hua screamed and looked at Wang Yan, "Wang Yan! This is the classmate you invited! Do you also invite such a mean-mouthed guy!"

Wang Yan's face darkened and he said to Li Chengzhang, "Chengzhang, that's enough. We are all classmates. You should give me face and apologize to Yang Hua."

"Wang Yan, are you pretending to be your mother?"

Li Chengzhang's eyes turned cold, "Why didn't you say anything when she scolded me just now? Now you're here to pretend to be a good person and ask me to give you face. Are you a fool? Do you really think your family is awesome if you open a few shabby supermarkets? I haven't even told you about your cheating on my brother Ye Fan's girlfriend!"

Wang Yan clenched his fists and glared at Li Chengzhang. Li Chengzhang didn't care. "Wang Yan, let me tell you the truth. The first reason why I came here today is to scold Yang Hua, a fat guy. The second reason is to warn you specifically! Ye Fan is my brother. If you cheat on his girlfriend, you are bullying me! So you'd better pray that Ye Fan is okay, otherwise, I will kill you!"
